articles.title: 'This time actually seems different': Crypto veterans brace for more pain as bitcoin tumbles
articles.snippet: Crypto sentiment is near rock bottom, but Galaxy sees room for a deeper slide and even longtime crypto bulls are wary of buying amid fears of AI and quantum computing.

articles.title: Vibecoded GTA 6 PC Ports Are Now Rendering In-Game Graphics Despite Take-Two Crackdown
articles.snippet: Some unofficial ports now hit around 20 frames per second, as developers move their work into private communities to dodge takedowns.

articles.title: Take-Two Hits GTA 6 PC Port Leonida With DMCA, Taking Down 3,007 GitHub Repos
articles.snippet: Rockstar's parent said the project's "bring your own files" instruction was a misleading attempt to dodge responsibility for the leak.
